answer.rationale: Finance mandate forces price-down choice; incumbent has refused. Memory c2 records that switching primary supply to the low-cost vendor cut unit cost sharply last year, onboarding was quick, and invoicing stayed accurate. Given exactly one action this cycle and 14 days to expiry, switching primary vendor meets the mandate alone on price (per the quoted terms in the situation), avoids waiting for the renewal that won't reopen, and inherits a recent, specific verification that onboarding risk is low and invoicing accuracy is acceptable. Delivery risk from the 94%-utilized line is mitigated by the prior record of quick onboarding rather than by adding a second source this cycle (which would only act as a hedge, not address the price cut or the expiry). action_label = switch_primary_vendor; this fits candidate 'switch_primary_vendor'. The mandate also says do not increase delivery risk, so I would not pair it with adding a second source now — exactly one decision this cycle.
